newsitem.title: USA: Sparton posts Q2 Dec 31 profit after sale.
newsitem.headline: Sparton posts Q2 Dec 31 profit after sale.

text.p: Sparton Corp said Wednesday it posted a profit in the second quarter ended December 31 thanks to a gain from the sale of discontinued operations.

The company reported net income of $31.5 million, or $4.03 a share, compared to a loss of $1.1 million, or $0.15 a share, in the same period one year ago. Sales rose to $32.9 million from $23.6 million in the second quarter last year.

Sparton said the sale of discontinued automotive operations added $31.5 million to second-quarter results after taxes. Without the gain, the loss from continuing operations was $0.01 a share versus a loss of $0.09 a year ago.
Sparton makes technical products for several industries.
